name: Havre-Saint-Pierre
text: Havre-Saint-Pierre (French pronunciation: [avʁ sɛ̃ pjɛʁ]) is a municipality located on the north shore of the Gulf of St. Lawrence, in Côte-Nord region, Minganie RCM, Quebec, Canada.

depictions.name: Havre-Saint-Pierre
depictions.text: Havre-Saint-Pierre is a town situated on the north shore of the St. Lawrence River in Quebec, Canada. At the time of the 18th century, the area was home to a French settlement, protected by a palissade wall, that had been constructed near the coast.
